rationale: The agent looked up the user and order, but then executed an exchange without first obtaining explicit user confirmation, violating the confirm-before-write requirement. The conversation provides no evidence that the selected replacement items were validated against the user’s stated constraints (clicky + RGB + full-size, fallback to no backlight) or thermostat compatibility (Google Home). It also failed to provide a final, correct summary of the changes (items, costs, return/shipping steps). These gaps mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
